", "cc": p('email.supportTeam.cc'), "attachments": [] }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload filter ((item) -> (! isEmpty(item.Descriptor.Id) and ! isEmpty(item.Descriptor.Name)) and ((item.Level == 1 and ! isEmpty(item.Descriptor.Id) and ! isEmpty(item.Descriptor.Name)) or (item.Level == 2 and ! isEmpty(item.Level1Descriptor.Id) and ! isEmpty(item.Level1Descriptor.Name)) or (item.Level == 3 and ! isEmpty(item.Level2Descriptor.Id) and ! isEmpty(item.Level2Descriptor.Name)) or (item.Level == 4 and ! isEmpty(item.Level3Descriptor.Id) and ! isEmpty(item.Level3Descriptor.Name)) or (item.Level == 5 and ! isEmpty(item.Level4Descriptor.Id) and ! isEmpty(item.Level4Descriptor.Name)) or (item.Level == 6 and ! isEmpty(item.Level5Descriptor.Id) and ! isEmpty(item.Level5Descriptor.Name))))

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json var grouped = payload groupBy ((item) -> item.Descriptor.Id) --- flatten( grouped filterObject ((val, key) -> sizeOf(val) > 1) pluck ((value, key) -> value[1 to -1]) )

ee:transform.doc:name: Set BU Array and SF query to Fetch data

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- "Select Id,Baird_BU_ID__c from Account where RecordType.DeveloperName = " ++ "'" ++ p('sfQuery.recordTypeDevName') ++ "'"
%dw 2.0 output application/json var invalidIds = (vars.sfResponse.Baird_BU_ID__c) -- (payload..Id) --- vars.sfResponse filter ((item) -> invalidIds contains item.Baird_BU_ID__c)
